description: Milestone 3 test cases covering all agent scenarios: duplicate, related, unrelated, known root cause, and insufficient evidence.

test_cases.name: Likely Duplicate — NullPointerException in NetworkManager
test_cases.description: Bug very similar to historical defect MOZ-1001. Expects likely_duplicate classification.

bug.title: NullPointerException in NetworkManager when connection is lost
bug.description: The application throws a NullPointerException when the network connection drops during an active download. The connection object is accessed without null check in the retry handler.
bug.stack_trace:
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke method getStatus() on null object
	at com.app.network.NetworkManager.retryConnection(NetworkManager.java:247)
	at com.app.network.NetworkManager.handleConnectionLoss(NetworkManager.java:189)
	at com.app.download.DownloadManager.onNetworkEvent(DownloadManager.java:312)
bug.error_logs:
ERROR [NetworkManager] Connection object is null in retry handler
WARN  [DownloadManager] Retry attempt 3/3 failed
FATAL [DownloadManager] Unrecoverable download failure

test_cases.name: Related Issue — Race Condition in Thread Pool
test_cases.description: Bug related to but not identical to APC-2002 (race condition/deadlock). Expects related_issue classification.

bug.title: Race condition in connection pool causing intermittent failures under load
bug.description: Under high concurrency, the connection pool occasionally returns already-in-use connections. This causes intermittent 'connection already in use' errors. The issue is reproducible at >500 concurrent users.
bug.stack_trace:
java.lang.IllegalStateException: Connection is already in use
	at com.app.pool.ConnectionPool.checkout(ConnectionPool.java:156)
	at com.app.service.DatabaseService.getConnection(DatabaseService.java:89)
	at com.app.api.RequestHandler.processRequest(RequestHandler.java:45)
bug.error_logs:
WARN  [ConnectionPool] Thread-0 attempting to checkout connection already held by Thread-7
ERROR [ConnectionPool] Race condition detected: concurrent access to pool slot 3
WARN  [ConnectionPool] Retry 2/3 for connection checkout

test_cases.name: New Unmatched — CSS Grid Rendering Regression
test_cases.description: UI rendering bug unrelated to any historical defect. Expects new_unmatched classification.

bug.title: CSS Grid layout breaks with nested flex containers after v2.5 upgrade
bug.description: After upgrading to v2.5, dashboard cards no longer render correctly. Grid columns collapse to single column when parent has display:flex. The issue only occurs in Chrome 118+ and does not reproduce in Firefox or Safari.
bug.error_logs:
WARN  [LayoutEngine] Grid template columns recalculated unexpectedly
WARN  [LayoutEngine] auto-fit minmax constraint ignored for nested flex child

test_cases.name: Known Root Cause — Memory Leak in Tab Renderer
test_cases.description: Bug with clear root cause evidence matching historical defect MOZ-1002. Tests that root cause agent surfaces historical resolution.

bug.title: Memory leak in browser tab renderer when rapidly switching between tabs
bug.description: Browser memory usage increases by approximately 50MB per 100 tab switches and never recovers. Heap dump shows render context objects are not being garbage collected. Issue causes browser crash after extended use.
bug.stack_trace:
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
	at java.util.Arrays.copyOf(Arrays.java:3537)
	at com.browser.render.TabRenderer.createRenderContext(TabRenderer.java:445)
	at com.browser.ui.TabManager.switchTab(TabManager.java:112)
bug.error_logs:
ERROR [TabRenderer] OutOfMemoryError: unable to allocate render context
WARN  [TabManager] Memory pressure detected: heap at 92%
ERROR [GarbageCollector] Full GC unable to free sufficient memory

test_cases.name: Insufficient Evidence — Vague Bug Report
test_cases.description: Bug with minimal information: no stack trace, no error logs, and a vague description. Tests that agents handle sparse data gracefully.

test_cases.name: Security Vulnerability — SQL Injection
test_cases.description: Security bug with clear root cause (SQL injection). Tests critical severity classification and security-specific remediation.

bug.title: SQL injection vulnerability in login endpoint allows authentication bypass
bug.description: The login endpoint concatenates user-supplied credentials directly into SQL queries without parameterization. An attacker can supply ' OR '1'='1 as username to bypass authentication. Confirmed exploitable in production.
bug.stack_trace:
org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: syntax error at or near "'"
	at com.app.auth.LoginController.authenticate(LoginController.java:78)
	at com.app.auth.AuthFilter.doFilter(AuthFilter.java:45)
bug.error_logs:
ERROR [LoginController] SQL syntax error in authentication query
WARN  [Security] Potential injection attempt detected from IP 192.168.1.100
ERROR [Database] Query execution failed: invalid syntax

test_cases.name: Python ValueError — Date Parsing Failure
test_cases.description: Python exception with clear stack trace. Tests Python stack trace parsing and root cause analysis.

bug.title: ValueError in date parsing when input contains non-ISO format dates
bug.description: The report generation module crashes with ValueError when processing CSV imports containing dates in DD/MM/YYYY format. The parser only handles ISO 8601 format.
bug.stack_trace:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/reports/generator.py", line 156, in parse_date
    return datetime.strptime(date_str, '%Y-%m-%d')
ValueError: time data '15/01/2024' does not match format '%Y-%m-%d'
bug.error_logs:
ERROR [ReportGenerator] Failed to parse date: 15/01/2024
WARN  [CSVImporter] 47 rows contain non-standard date formats
ERROR [BatchProcessor] Batch aborted after 3 consecutive parse failures

test_cases.name: Node.js TypeError — Undefined Property Access
test_cases.description: Node.js error with stack trace. Tests Node.js parsing and agent handling.

bug.title: TypeError when accessing user.profile in session middleware after logout
bug.description: After a user logs out and attempts to access a protected route, the session middleware crashes because user.profile is undefined. The session is cleared but the middleware still attempts to read profile properties.
bug.stack_trace:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'displayName')
    at SessionMiddleware.enrichRequest (/app/middleware/session.js:89:24)
    at Layer.handle [as handle_request] (/app/node_modules/express/lib/router/layer.js:95:5)
    at next (/app/node_modules/express/lib/router/route.js:137:13)
bug.error_logs:
ERROR [SessionMiddleware] user.profile is undefined after logout
WARN  [SessionStore] Session TTL expired for user abc123
ERROR [RequestHandler] Unhandled exception in middleware chain
